mapper.sql: select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.login_name, u.user_name, u.user_type, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.sex, u.password, u.salt, u.status, u.allow_admin_login, u.allow_mini_login, u.audit_status, u.register_source, u.register_invite_id, u.audit_by, u.audit_time, u.audit_remark, u.dispatchable, u.openid, u.union_id, u.wx_bind_time, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.pwd_update_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.update_by, u.update_time, u.remark, d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.status as dept_status, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status as role_status from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id
mapper.select:
select distinct u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.login_name, u.user_name, u.user_type, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.status, u.create_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.del_flag = '0' and (r.role_id != #{roleId} or r.role_id IS NULL) and u.user_id not in (select u.user_id from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id and ur.role_id = #{roleId})
AND u.login_name like concat('%', #{loginName}, '%')
AND u.phonenumber like concat('%', #{phonenumber}, '%')
${params.dataScope}
select count(1) from sys_user where phonenumber = #{phonenumber}
select user_id, login_name from sys_user where login_name=#{loginName} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, phonenumber from sys_user where phonenumber=#{phonenumber} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, email from sys_user where email=#{email} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.delete: update sys_user set del_flag = '2' where user_id = #{userId}

update sys_user set del_flag = '2' where user_id in
#{userId}
mapper.update: update sys_user set avatar = #{avatar} where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user SET pwd_update_date = sysdate(), password = #{password}, salt = #{salt}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user SET status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set login_ip = #{loginIp}, login_date = #{loginDate} where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user( user_id, dept_id, login_name, user_name, user_type, email, avatar, phonenumber, sex, password, salt, status, allow_admin_login, allow_mini_login, audit_status, register_source, register_invite_id, audit_by, audit_time, audit_remark, dispatchable, openid, union_id, wx_bind_time, pwd_update_date, create_by, remark, create_time )values( #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{loginName}, #{userName}, #{userType}, #{email}, #{avatar}, #{phonenumber}, #{sex}, #{password}, #{salt}, #{status}, #{allowAdminLogin}, #{allowMiniLogin}, #{auditStatus}, #{registerSource}, #{registerInviteId}, #{auditBy}, #{auditTime}, #{auditRemark}, #{dispatchable}, #{openid}, #{unionId}, #{wxBindTime}, #{pwdUpdateDate}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sys_user set audit_status = #{auditStatus}, audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, dispatchable = #{dispatchable}, dept_id = #{deptId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and audit_status = '1' and del_flag = '0'
